name: switch
title: Switch
description: A switch whose thumb travels on a spring and stretches while pressed. The new colour grows as a circle from the press point instead of fading through grey.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Switch from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/motion-switch".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-switch.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createSwitch on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/switch/switch.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#switch
